title: Weekend standby: quick announce + Q&A script (scratch)
content:
Purpose

Quick personal scratchpad: draft outbound announcement + internal Q&A script for the Weekend Standby plan we run when we anticipate heavy traffic or when infra maintenance windows could affect hosted endpoints. This is a lightweight, rapid-circulation note — not final. Use as basis for Slack post + optional short email to eng leads.

Audience
- Primary: On-call SREs and ops backups
- Secondary: Eng leads for hosted API, customer success on rotation, solutions-eng for customer escalations

High-level goals
- Make the standby expectations explicit (what to watch, how to escalate)
- Provide a short canned announcement SREs can post into #oncall-ops and #hosting-status if needed
- Provide quick Q&A bullets for common questions from PMs/eng leads
- Surface known risks and mitigation steps

Suggested subject / Slack header (short)
- "Weekend Standby: short notice — monitoring + escalation script"

Suggested Slack post (postable, short)
- TL;DR: We're entering a Weekend Standby (reason: predicted high traffic / rolling infra patch). On-call rotations remain unchanged; follow standby checklist. If you see 5xx spike or pod OOMs, immediately: 1) open INF-4321; 2) ping @oncall-sre; 3) notify CS lead if customer affected. Full runbook: confluence link.

Short email blurb (if we need to notify leads)
- Hi all — quick heads-up: we are running a Weekend Standby from Fri 18:00 -> Mon 08:00 UTC due to scheduled infra changes and elevated traffic forecast. On-call SREs will run the standby checklist (link). If your team plans any risky deploys or capacity changes, please postpone until after Monday or coordinate with on-call. Thanks — Felix (SRE)

Standby checklist (one-liners for quick reference)
- Confirm alert routing intact (PagerDuty check)
- Verify monitoring dashboards (latency P50/P95, 5xx rate, queue depth)
- Ensure autoscaler health and headroom for critical pools (hosting-api, batch-embeddings)
- Confirm KV cache warming state for expected prefixes (if applicable)
- Watch model rollout flags — no canaries during standby unless explicitly approved
- Have fallback model variant IDs handy: rwd-small-v1-q8, rwd-medium-v2-fp16
- Confirm contact for cust escalations: lina@redwood.ai (CS lead)

Escalation steps (short)
1) Triage in Slack #oncall-ops with INF-4321 ticket linked
2) If latency > SLO and > 20% customers affected -> PD high priority + page Eng Lead
3) If model-serving nodes are OOM-ing or kernel crash -> page Infra Eng on-duty
4) Customer-impacting incidents: loop in CS support + Solutions Eng as triage

Canned answers for likely Qs (internal)
- Q: "Is there any maintenance that will impact customers?"
  A: Basic rolling patching is scheduled but we expect graceful fallbacks. If we see sustained 5xx we will open a customer-impact incident and send status updates.
- Q: "Can we still deploy a model A/B test over the weekend?"
  A: Not recommended. No canaries during standby unless approved by SRE lead and Product.
- Q: "What thresholds should I watch?"
  A: >0.5% 5xx over 15m, >30% increase in P95 latency over baseline, CPU or GPU throttle events on serving nodes.

Open questions / TODOs (for me & Marta)
- Confirm exact timezone window with infra (Rowan to confirm maintenance start anchor) — TODO: update headers once confirmed
- Decide if we push a light-touch email to top 20 customers (CS input) — Marta to propose list
- Update fallback model list with any new quantized variants from last week (check PR #986)

Quick handoff script for on-call
- On shift start: read this doc + ping backup; verify PD routing and dashboards; copy canned slack post to clipboard
- If paged: run triage checklist, capture metric snapshots (links), escalate if customer impact detected

Notes to self (scratchy)
- Keep message short; don't overload with technical details — link to runbook for full steps
- Keep internal Q&A sections lightweight so eng leads can forward easily
- Add post-mortem template link here after event

Links and artifacts (copy for final message)
- Runbook: https://confluence.redwood.internal/display/OPS/Weekend+Standby+Runbook
- Ticket template: INF-4321
- PR to watch: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/986 (autoscaler patch)

Planned next steps before publish
- Rowan to confirm window by Fri 2026-03-06 EOD
- Marta to draft customer shortlist if email needed
- I will turn this scratch into a short Slack post + pinned runbook link when window locked

Scratch log (versions)

- v1: after Rowan confirms window, swap placeholders and finalize subject lines
- v2: post-review w/ CS and product — finalize and mark status: final
